title: Surface manifest (frame.json)
description: The manifest an agent writes at artifacts/{agent}/{deck}/{surface}/v/{version}/frame.json. The path is the identity; agent/deck/surface/version are not repeated here.

handlers.description: Sandboxed handlers keyed by backflow action. The server runs the matching handler when an interaction with that action arrives (opt-in via --enable-handlers). Handlers never edit the surface; they fold the backflow log into the surface's KV view.

entry.description: Entry file relative to the version dir, e.g. main.js / main.lua / main.wasm.

capabilities.description: Default-deny: an absent field grants nothing.

http.description: Allowed outbound HTTP hosts (exact match). Empty ⇒ no network.

fs.description: Read/write within the surface's jailed state/ dir.

limits.description: Hard limits enforced host-side, identically across engines.

nav.description: Edges to other surfaces in the deck, by surface slug.

metadata.description: Free-form agent data — the only place unknown keys are allowed.
